–AGENDA–
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  BUILDING AND FIRE BOARD OF APPEALS

  CITY OF GLENDALE, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  MSB Room 105, 633 E. Broadway, Glendale, CA 91206

 Welcome to the regular meeting of the Building and Fire Board of Appeals. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout
 the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by calling
 (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Municipal Services Building, Room 105.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon
 request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign
 language translation and Braille transcription services.

 If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Community Development Department at (818) 548-2140
 during regular business hours.

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2019 AT 2:00 P.M.
1.  ROLL CALL: Tatoulian, Lee, Keshishian, Aharonian, Hanessian

2.  REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting will be posted on Monday, September 16, 2019, on the bulletin
  board outside City Hall and on the City’s web site.

3.  PRESENTATIONS AND COMMENDATIONS

   Building and Safety Updates
   Fire Prevention Updates

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
   July 17, 2019

5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is limited to 5 minutes.
  The Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

6.  OLD BUSINESS
  NONE

7.  NEW BUSINESS
 AGENDA  2
BUILDING AND FIRE BOARD OF APPEALS
Wednesday, September 18, 2019

  A. Introduction of proposed local amendments to Title-24, C.C.R. for the 2020
  Glendale Building and Safety Code.

  APPLICANT:  City of Glendale

  DESCRIPTION:  Public hearing to enable Building Official and Fire
  Marshal to present proposed local amendments to
  Title-24 C.C.R., which would take effect commencing
  on January 1, 2020.

  Attachment 1- Staff Report
  Attachment 2- Analysis of Amendments
  Attachment 3- Volume IA
  Attachment 4- Volume IB
  Attachment 5- Volume IC
  Attachment 6- Volume II, III, IV
  Attachment 7- Volume V
  Attachment 8- Volume VI
  Attachment 9- Volume VII
  Attachment 10- Volume VIII
  Attachment 11- Volume IX

  STAFF:  Jan Bear

  RECOMMENDATION:  Community Development Department and Fire
  Department staff recommends that the Building and
  Fire Board of Appeals review and consider the
  proposed amendments to Title-24, C.C.R.
  Furthermore, it is recommended that staff be directed
  to consider input from Board Members, and the public,
  and return a final draft of the proposed amendments for
  Board approval on October 18, ,2019.

8.  Reports- Information Only

  a. Recent Building Activity Report and Monthly Income Summaries.

9.  Adjournment

BUILDING & FIRE BOARD OF APPEALS
  MEETING MINUTES
  09/18/2019
The Building and Fire Board of Appeals meeting convened at 2:04 p.m. in the MSB Room 105,
with Chairman Erik Keshishian presiding.

  I.  ROLL CALL
  PRESENT:  Keshishian, Tatoulian, Aharonian, Lee, Hanessian
  ABSENT:  NONE

  Staff Members Present:
  Jan Bear, Building Official
  Jeff Ragusa, Fire Battalion Chief
  Doug Nickles, Assistant Fire Marshal
  Kirsten Billing, Recording Secretary
  Jeff Halpert, Fire Protection Engineer II
  Chris Agus, Building Code Specialist III
  Jovan Diaz, Principal Fire Environmental Safety Specialist
  Jeremy Cawn, Fire Prevention Inspector

  II.  REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
   The agenda for this meeting has been posted on Monday, September 16, 2019 on
  the bulletin board outside City Hall and on the City’s Website

  III.  PRESENTATIONS & COMMENDATIONS
   Building Official Jan Bear discussed Building and Safety updates.
   Fire Battalion Chief Jeff Ragusa discussed Fire Prevention updates.

  IV.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETING –
  July 17, 2019
  Board member Steven Lee made a motion that the minutes be approved as submitted,
  seconded by board member Ara Aharonian.
  ROLL CALL:
  AYES:  Keshishian, Tatoulian, Aharonian, Lee, Hanessian
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  NONE

  V.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  NONE

  VI.  OLD BUSINESS
  NONE
 VII.  NEW BUSINESS - Introduction of proposed local amendments to Title-24, C.C.R.
  for the 2020 Glendale Building and Safety Code.
  APPLICANT: City of Glendale
  DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to enable Building Official and Fire Marshal to
  present proposed local amendments to Title-24 C.C.R., which would take effect
  commencing on January 1, 2020.
  Attachment 1- Staff Report
  Attachment 2- Analysis of Amendments
  Attachment 3- Volume IA
  Attachment 4- Volume IB
  Attachment 5- Volume IC
  Attachment 6- Volume II, III, IV
  Attachment 7- Volume V
  Attachment 8- Volume VI
  Attachment 9- Volume VII
  Attachment 10- Volume VIII
  Attachment 11- Volume IX
  STAFF: Jan Bear
  RECOMMENDATION: Community Development Department and Fire Department staff
  recommends that the Building and Fire Board of Appeals review and consider the proposed
  amendments to Title-24, C.C.R. Furthermore, it is recommended that staff be directed to
  consider input from Board Members, and the public, and return a final draft of the
  proposed amendments for Board approval on October 16, ,2019.

VIII. REPORTS- Information Only
   Building & Safety monthly income summary of June 2019.

IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Board member John Tatoulian moved that the meeting be adjourned,
  seconded by board member Ara Aharonian.
  There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:47 p.m.
